items.item: (1) 08 §2: the defined term for kinds of claim
items.how: Heading '2. Standings and bases' became '2. How far it has been seen: labels and bases'; <a id="standings-and-bases"> kept (every anchor of 08 kept: 76 before and after, the same set). One line added to 'What a label tells': 'The label says what kind of claim the statement is and how far it has been seen; until 9 November 2026 this was called its standing.' The table rows: Thesis (chapter opening) 'a chapter's claim in one paragraph, seen as far as the results it summarizes'; Thesis Tn 'an empirical claim, with how far it has been seen, what it forbids and the evidence so far'. The words table's row 'standing' became 'how far seen' ('how far a result has been seen, as its label says (here)'), its Not column keeping 02's sense: 'a level's standing, which is persistence: a level stands, comes to stand, ceases to stand (02)'; 02 is untouched. Beyond the spots the brief listed, still in §2: 'Sorted by standing, the whole comes in four layers' became 'Sorted by what each part rests on, ...' (the four layers are no premise, each premise, where the dynamics stop deciding, evaluation's premises), because the line just added says the word was retired.

The bold lead is now 'How far the root reaches' (the connection map's heading for the same view, and 08's own gloss of the edge at 'What a response takes in'). The next sentence, 'Each of the 117 distinct central declarations has one standing against the edge of one root', is left: spine.json quotes it twice (its text and its 117 count phrase, which spine.check reads), correspondences.json three times, the edge record's statement in its own form; see left.
